group.note: Category column. Blank = the first non-numeric column.

value.note: Numeric column to rank. Blank = the first numeric column.

estimator.note: The value each dot sits at. Median is the default because a ranking is usually read off the median.

sort.note: none keeps the order the rows arrived in.

orientation.note: Horizontal by default — a ranking reads top-to-bottom and long category names get real room.

error_bars.note: 95% CI from a seeded percentile bootstrap. Needs at least 3 values per category; a pre-aggregated table gets none rather than a fabricated one.

add_tip.note: Print each value beside its dot.

baseline.note: Where the stems start. 0 for a magnitude; set it to a reference level for a deviation.

order.note: Pin named categories first; the rest stay ranked.

pairs.note: "A~B, C~D" — significance brackets. Ignored on a pre-aggregated table, where every test would be n=1 vs n=1.

catalog.name: Selom Lollipop Chart
catalog.summary: Ranked stem-and-dot chart of one value per category — the cleaner alternative to a bar chart when the point of the figure is the ordering. Carries a 95% bootstrap confidence interval on the median (a bar chart's mean±SEM has no non-parametric equivalent), and refuses to invent one on an already-aggregated table. Optional significance brackets between named pairs.
